answer: Anchor each agent to a national jury-duty service record: courts summon citizens by name, attendance is logged in person, and forging a summons is a crime. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents would need a thousand real people to appear in court, a quartz-hard cost that breaks the attack at its nadir. The limit is coverage, since jury systems exist only in some countries, so it works as one shale layer in a stack of checks rather than a standalone proof.
